rows.title: An Intra-individual Titration Study of KRN1493 for the Treatment of Hypercalcemia in Patients With Parathyroid Carcinoma or Intractable Primary Hyperparathyroidism
rows.quote: Five Japanese patients with parathyroid carcinoma and two with intractable PHPT were enrolled in an open-label, single-arm study consisting of titration and maintenance phases.
rows.why: This matches the registry's disease population, open-label single-arm titration design, and Japanese KRN1493 study, unlike the 29-patient carcinoma trial or reviews.

rows.title: A Phase II Trial Neoadjuvant Paclitaxel and Cisplatin in Patients With Locally Advanced Head and Neck Cancer
rows.why: None of the PubMed records mentions paclitaxel, NCT00337532, or a 50-patient neoadjuvant paclitaxel-cisplatin trial.

rows.title: Thalidomide 100 mg/Day Versus Thalidomide 400 mg/Day in Relapse Refractory Multiple Myeloma
rows.why: None of the PubMed records describe thalidomide 100 mg/day versus 400 mg/day in relapsed/refractory myeloma or NCT00657488.

rows.title: Clinical Use and Safety of the Fentanyl Transdermal Therapeutic System (TTS) in the Management of Pain in Patients With Cancer
rows.why: None of the PubMed records matches the 1988 cancer-pain TTS trial with 32 participants and NCT00269763.

rows.sponsor: Johnson & Johnson Pharmaceutical Research & Development, L.L.C.
rows.title: The Effect of Epoetin Alfa on the Anemia of Patients With Selected Cancers Receiving Chemotherapy
rows.why: None of the records describes a 1998 placebo-controlled epoetin alfa trial in selected cancers receiving chemotherapy with 201 patients.

rows.title: Treatment Protocol to Monitor the Safety of a 200 mg Dose of Bicalutamide in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer
rows.why: No record describes a 101-patient single-arm safety protocol of 200 mg bicalutamide (NCT00846976).

rows.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety and Immunogenicity of Leucostim® Versus Neupogen® in Breast Cancer Patients
rows.why: None of the PubMed records describe Leucostim versus Neupogen in 143 breast cancer patients; they report XM02, Zarzio, EP2006, or tbo-filgrastim trials and pooled/review analyses.

rows.title: ATAC - Bone Density Sub-Protocol
rows.why: None of the PubMed records reports the ATAC bone density sub-protocol of anastrozole vs tamoxifen vs combination in postmenopausal breast cancer; they are reviews or different trials like SABRE.

rows.title: Efficacy and Safety of DLBS1425 as Neoadjuvant in Stage II or III Breast Cancer Patients
rows.why: None of the PubMed records study DLBS1425 with anthracycline as neoadjuvant therapy in stage II-III breast cancer.

rows.sponsor: Endo USA Inc., a Keenova Therapeutics Company
rows.title: Long-Term Safety, Efficacy, and Durability of EN3835 in the Treatment and Retreatment of Plantar Fibromatosis
Safety and Efficacy Trial of Recombinant Human Granulocyte Colony Stimulating Factor (GCSF)
rows.why: No PubMed record matches the Shantha rhG-CSF vs Neupogen phase 3 trial in 126 non-myeloid malignancy patients, as all records involve different drugs, populations, sizes, or trial numbers.

rows.title: A Trial Comparing the Efficacy and Tolerability of Faslodex With Nolvadex in Postmenopausal Women With Advanced Breast Cancer
rows.why: None of the five records compares fulvestrant/Faslodex versus tamoxifen/Nolvadex in postmenopausal advanced breast cancer as a 51-patient double-blind trial.

rows.title: Chemotherapy Drug Sensitivity Microculture (MiCK) Assay for Apoptosis
rows.why: None of the five records describes the MiCK apoptosis assay trial in solid tumors with 150 participants.

rows.title: A Study of Recombinant Human Erythropoietin in Anemic Cancer Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy
rows.why: No PubMed record studies recombinant human erythropoietin in anemic cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy with matching size, design, or NCT00144495.

rows.title: Clinical Trial of YYD701-2 for Treatment of Nasolabial Folds
rows.why: None of the records test YYD701-2 versus Restylane Perlane Lidocaine in nasolabial folds with matching design and size.

rows.title: Paclitaxel or Docetaxel in Treating Women With Advanced Breast Cancer
rows.why: No PubMed record reports a phase 3 docetaxel versus paclitaxel trial in advanced breast cancer matching NCT00002662.

rows.title: Study Comparing Weekly Taxol and Carboplatin vs Standard Taxol and Carboplatin Regimen for Stage IIIB or IV Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
rows.why: None of the PubMed records describes weekly versus every-3-weeks paclitaxel-carboplatin for stage IIIB/IV NSCLC with 444 patients or NCT00035152.

rows.sponsor: Cubist Pharmaceuticals LLC, a subsidiary of Merck & Co., Inc. (Rahway, New Jersey USA)
rows.title: Long-Term Safety Evaluation Of Treatment Of Constipation Due To Opioids Being Taken For Persistent Non-Cancer Pain
rows.why: None reports a 12-month alvimopan vs placebo trial in non-cancer opioid-induced bowel dysfunction with 805 patients; all are reviews or trials in postoperative ileus or other populations.

rows.title: Comparison of the Safety and Successful Ablation of Thyroid Remnant in Post-thyroidectomized Euthyroid Patients (i.e. Patients Administered Thyrogen) Versus Hypothyroid Patients (no Thyrogen) Following 131I Administration
rows.why: The record is a pediatric thyroid cancer review mentioning thyrogen generally and does not report the 63-patient randomized Thyrogen versus hypothyroid ablation trial.

rows.title: Safety and Efficacy of (PN-152,243)/PN-196,444 in the Prevention of Thrombocytopenia
rows.why: None of the PubMed records study PN-152,243/PN-196,444 for thrombocytopenia in sarcoma patients receiving Adriamycin-Ifosfamide.

rows.title: Impact of Erythropoietin Treatment Versus Placebo on Quality-of-life in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer.
rows.quote: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of epoetin alfa in men with castration-resistant prostate cancer and anemia.
rows.why: This title matches the registry's drug (epoetin alfa), comparator (placebo), design (randomized double-blind), and disease (prostate cancer with anemia).

rows.title: Comparative Bioequivalence Study in Adult Patients Suffering From Chronic Myeloid Leukemia & Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor Under Fed Conditions
rows.why: No PubMed record describes a 48-patient fed bioequivalence crossover of Amneal imatinib 400 mg vs Gleevec in CML/GIST; all records concern asciminib, dasatinib, or long-term imatinib efficacy, not this bioequivalence trial.

rows.title: Safety of Treatment of Uterine Fibroids With Asoprisnil
rows.why: No PubMed record describes the 18-month extension with 166 participants (NCT00156208); the closest extension report describes up to 12 additional months in 436 continuing asoprisnil patients, not this trial.

rows.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ralfinamide in Patients With Chronic Neuropathic Low Back Pain
rows.why: Neither PubMed record reports the 411-patient Phase III low back pain trial results; both are preclinical animal-model studies of ralfinamide/QLS-81.

rows.title: Clinical Study of NPC-12Y Gel in Patients With Skin Lesions Associated With TSC
A Study to Evaluate Avastin in Patients Treated in a Previous Genentech-Sponsored Cancer Study
rows.why: No PubMed record describes an open-label multicenter extension study in prior Genentech-study patients with ~100 participants; all are reviews, historical pieces, or different phase III trials.

rows.title: A Study of Ibandronate (Bondronat) in Participants With Malignant Bone Disease
rows.why: None of the PubMed records describes a 97-patient randomized open-label IV versus oral ibandronate trial in malignant bone disease.

rows.title: Efficacy and Safety of Fibrin Sealant Vapor Heated Solvent/Detergent Treated (FS VH S/D) for Reduction of Lymphatic Leakage by Sealing Axillary Lymph Node Dissection Sites
rows.why: None of the PubMed records studies Fibrin Sealant VH S/D versus surgery alone for axillary lymph node dissection lymphatic leakage.
